context.purpose: Build editable mechanical parts from constrained profile intent, explicit frames or checked planar attachments, and ordered native multi-Body histories. Compose stock, cavities, bosses, slots, turned features, dress-ups, patterns, lofts and unthreaded drilling/head recesses; publish one selected final solid as FCStd/STEP/STL while retaining all authored Bodies natively. Primitives/booleans, checked single-solid STEP import, named measurements, bounded batches, affine native length drivers and the separately bounded scalar designStudy remain available. Uniform native shells express wall/floor thickness and exact planar opening intent once, then compose with bosses and drilling. Editable sweep/path intent composes hollow elbows, varying sections and attached face-centred flanges/bores. Apply mould-release Draft to measured planar/cylindrical walls about a same-Body neutral profile plane, with optional native pull axis, and compose with uniform walls, bosses and drilling. Native engineering tables retain mixed-unit length inputs and affine formula aliases that drive the same finite dimension targets. Editable straight-edged Draft Wire outlines compose Part extrusions and booleans. Seed an editable Body from a checked STEP/STL import or supported typed Part solid, retain the original captured assets, and declare the Body frame explicitly for downstream sourced assemblies.
context.assumptions: Lengths are millimetres; angles are degrees. Each Body represents one manufactured part and has its own owner/member/current-tip history. Typed declarations execute through public FreeCAD document, Sketcher, Part and PartDesign APIs in isolated native processes; authored data cannot select arbitrary native code or property paths.
context.constraints: Select one valid positive-volume final solid tip; Body containers, datums and profiles are not solid outputs. Every PartDesign feature must continue its own Body current tip and use unused same-Body profiles; no feature branching or silent mixed Part/PartDesign dependencies. Multiple Bodies and subsequent Pads are supported. Profiles use orthonormal independent frames or exact-cardinality extreme Cartesian planar-face attachments; curved/rotated support faces and general topology repair remain open. General sketches cover reviewed lines/circles/arcs and named relation types, not arbitrary Sketcher geometry. Hole is common unthreaded drilling; threads, taper, standards tables and up-to-face modes remain open. Uniform Skin shells support inward/outward offsets and sharp/rounded joins; general surfaces/variable thickness and topology repair remain open. Sweeps use connected planar line/circle/arc sketch paths and closed sections; arbitrary3D/spline paths, partial-edge selection and some upstream corner export behaviours remain gaps. Transformed corners require tangent continuity; invalid rounded STEP handoffs fail verification. Helix and broader feature extents remain gaps. Draft selects planar/cylindrical source faces only; neutral references are earlier same-Body profiles and optional pull axes are same-Body datumAxis objects. General native neutral-face, conical/spline surface selectors and angular parameter drivers remain gaps. Native affine length drivers are batch-only with reviewed finite targets; no angular-driver AST, live Body sessions, reverse synchronisation or PartDesign designStudy. Scalar designStudy is confined to its separate documented subset and sampled monotonic response assumptions. Checked importSTEP supplies one static solid with assigned units/declared facts within32MiB/100000entities/2000edges per loop; bodySeed can use it, a checked importMesh solid or a supported typed Part solid as the first member of an ordered Body. An explicit Body frame places seeded or ordinary typed Body histories in world space; profile/attachment selectors and assembly mounts remain Body-local; legacy readSTEP is refused in seeded histories. Kernel validity can still fail after host admission. STEP/STL lose feature history and STL approximates curved surfaces. Spreadsheet and VarSet parameters are alternatives. Spreadsheet tables have at most32 cells, unitful positive length inputs and acyclic affine formulas; nonlinear/angular/general-table/cross-document workflows remain missing. Draft profiles have 3 to 256 distinct local points and one closed planar boundary. Live Body sessions and general native-history adoption remain unavailable; sourced assembly-history copying accepts the finite typed Body-history capability with retained typed intent and original assets when present.
context.inspection: Verification checks native validity, solid count and shape facts, then independently reopens publications. Multi-Body records bind each native Group/Tip/owner, origin roles, profile/frame/attachment semantics, named geometry/constraints, current-base/profile links, feature settings and exact allowed expression engines. Saved FCStd XML is independently checked; present shape equality cannot replace editable feature intent. Geometric selectors retain exact source/match inventories. Native parameters retain typed VarSet membership and expressions. Hole retains actual diameter/extent/tip/recess semantics separately from marker radii. STEP unit/geometry and independently integrated STL volume/closure/centre/bounds use explicit deflection and float32 error budgets. Named measurements publish verified units/values for downstream consumers. Dedicated qualifier examples add analytic/neutral geometry, native edits/save/fresh reopen and refreshed-digest attacks; broader upstream coverage remains separately tracked. Draft retains complete measured source face inventory, exact selected Base links, neutral/pull references, angle/reversal and fixed support-transform/kernel-tolerance policy in native and saved readback. Spreadsheet cell membership, literal/formula grammar, aliases and display units are bound independently in saved XML before source restoration; actual unitful quantities are read separately on build and fresh reopen. Draft source geometry binds independently to typed polygon vertices/edges/winding, and the entire saved Part graph binds one coherent trusted fresh or first-reopen/save reference; submitted FCStd is never restored. Seeded source and assembly admission bind the complete saved history, maps and original asset bytes to trusted fresh typed reconstruction before opening submitted native documents; private assembly inspection carries the verified native digest.
context.recovery: Correct earlier-node references, same-Body ownership and current-tip/profile consumption before native execution. For invalid stock or non-removing cuts, inspect actual overlap/direction and use a fresh profile; every drilling centre must reach material. For missing or ambiguous face/edge selections inspect the geometry and intentional cardinality; no nearest-face substitution occurs. CONFLICTING_FRAME requires either an independent frame/plane/origin or support+onFace, never both. INVALID_HOLE_EXTENT/INVALID_HOLE_RECESS require exactly the chosen finite depth/tip/head dimensions and positive bore below its head recess. INVALID_POCKET_EXTENT requires finite length or throughAll without length. Driver faults require bounded declared parameter terms and omission of the driven literal. Import faults require the assigned STEP unit, supported one-solid content and correct orientation-sensitive expected facts. Preserve failures and rerun in a fresh directory after changing intent; inspect native recompute errors after topology-changing edits. RERUN_REQUIRED needs fresh hardened export evidence. Unmet designStudy goals retain their report; inspect bracket, response and limits before changing a target. For spreadsheet faults, correct aliases, units and cycles, retain positive derived lengths across independent input bounds, and remove unused or algebraically cancelled inputs. INVALID_BODY_SEED requires a first Body member with an earlier external solid source and no cross-Body member dependency. INVALID_FRAME requires finite perpendicular unit axes for an explicit Body layout. Use checked importSTEP/importMesh with assigned units instead of legacy readSTEP for seeded histories; retain captured assets and rerun from trusted intent rather than editing native maps or receipt hashes.

context.purpose: Create an editable native fixed assembly with reusable constructor parts or verified typed PartDesign source histories, component links and named mounting frames. One source definition preserves its complete document; repeated components share its selected output Body.
context.assumptions: Millimetre geometry, one grounded component and a bounded fixed-joint tree. Constructor parts use box/cylinder definitions. Sourced parts use verified schemaxis.freecad/1 model.FCStd publications (workflow artifact index 2), including qualified multi-Body histories; the selected final output determines the instantiated Body. FreeCAD computes native placements; host frame composition supplies the independent oracle.
context.constraints: Fixed joints only: top/bottom faces for constructor parts, named mounts with parent-side offset and clocking for sourced parts; the two part forms never mix. Sourced assemblies refuse the optional GUI capture stage. No revolute motion, persistent assembly process, live editing or node inspection. Common analytic studies and scheduled workflow resume are supported. Timeout applies to each native stage separately for constructor parts and to the whole run for sourced parts.
context.inspection: Inspect saved components, joints, mounts, complete embedded histories and native perturb/solve/reopen evidence. Typed mechanical histories additionally require a configured FreeCAD launcher for fresh source recapture and regeneration: every indexed history element and actual subelement consumer must correspond, and all saved maps, shadows and geometry payloads must bind to that regeneration. Consistent object/StringID allocation changes do not excuse changed names, dependencies or operation spans. A rendered view alone is insufficient.
context.recovery: INVALID_GROUND requires an existing component ID. Repair joint endpoints or connectivity for structural errors. UNSUPPORTED_SOURCE names a source outside the qualified typed PartDesign publication contract; INPUT_CHANGED requires rebuilding changed producer/consumer runs. VERIFICATION_RUNTIME_REQUIRED needs a trusted configured FreeCAD launcher for typed history verification. Keep failed evidence; do not repair map or shadow failures by refreshing hashes or flattening history.

DRAWING_OVERFLOW needs a smaller scale or in-sheet label positions. Changed sources or stale publications require a fresh run, preserving original evidence.

context.purpose: Construct and solve editable native linear static isotropic solid FEM from checked CAD geometry, with typed material, mesh, geometric supports and face forces/pressures.
context.assumptions: One homogeneous solid, small-displacement static elasticity, N/mm/MPa; straight-sided C3D4/C3D10 cells. Bundled FreeCAD1.1.x Gmsh and CalculiX2.23 are required.
context.constraints: Planar directional face selection must be unambiguous. Resource bounds, mesh/CAD volume tolerance and 2% face-area tolerance apply. No gravity, contact, nonlinear, shell/beam, multimaterial, thermal, modal or transient physics. Native cache equality alone is insufficient.
context.inspection: Inspect analysis.json, actual Mesh.inp/DAT/FRD and editable analysis.FCStd. Independent checks bind native mesh coordinates/connectivity, material, each nodal support/traction or pressure face, DAT/FRD/cache fields, force/moment equilibrium and strain-energy/external-work balance. Limits can be unmet while the calculation verifies.
context.recovery: Correct source units/facts, ambiguous faces and physically unstable supports; refine narrow walls/bores within resource bounds. Preserve failed evidence and use a fresh run directory. Rerun after material, support, load or geometry changes; editing a result cache does not solve the changed analysis.

context.purpose: Prescribe constant-speed angular or linear motion at named joints of a verified fixed assembly tree, retaining native Revolute/Slider joints, Simulation/Motion objects and a sampled mm/degrees/seconds trajectory.
context.assumptions: The initial assembly is grounded and fixed. Each motion starts at zero displacement and moves in its parent connector frame; offsets, clocking and serial parent motion compose. This is prescribed kinematics; it does not model loads, inertia, collisions or actuator feasibility.
context.constraints: One verified Schemaxis fixed-assembly publication or portable constructor packet; keep sourced producer run/provenance available. At most31 motions and240 intervals. Rotation is at most one revolution and15 degrees per interval. General closed loops, couplings, other joint types and arbitrary formula input remain unfinished. Each component remains a valid single solid. Both batch and private GUI runtimes are required; Xvfb/private D-Bus isolate native GUI settings and display.
context.inspection: Independent rigid-tree matrices, physical shape volume/solid count/centre of mass for every native frame, actual formula/type/joint/timing records, save/reopen and current-code regeneration. Verification never opens submitted mechanism files: it binds complete native object/dependency/property/GUI/payload state to trusted regeneration. Constructor source proxies are bound to a trusted native rebuild before opening. Native allocation IDs, UUID/create/save times and GUI payload filenames have explicit normalisation; referenced contents remain bound. Default constructor GUI root ranks are native owner IDs, bound under the object-ID bijection with explicit root order preserved; GUI-decorated constructors are regenerated with matching private GUI intent.
context.recovery: UNKNOWN_JOINT needs the source fixed-joint author ID. MOTION_RESOLUTION needs more intervals or less rotation. INVALID_MOTION needs a nonzero endpoint. UNSUPPORTED_SOURCE needs the complete matching producer packet; arbitrary FCStd files are refused. Retain failed logs and use a fresh directory after correcting intent. RUNNER_CANCELLED/RUNNER_TIMED_OUT retain incomplete evidence; do not treat partial frames as success.

context.purpose: Create an editable native CAM Job with named flat or pointed tools, facing, closed pockets and source-bound drilling cycles; independently check the LinuxCNC program and complete physical tool/holder access against captured finished geometry.
context.assumptions: Millimetres, top-centre G54 and a pre-sized blank. Legacy flat tools reach the whole blank; explicit aboveBlank or evolvingStock policies require complete fresh native physical geometry and a positive noncutting/holder gap.
context.constraints: Fixed vertical tools, planar/cylindrical pocket walls, finite blind/clipped/spot/through pointed targets and qualified circular rims. A finite optional reduced shank carries its exact tool extension and launcher. General split cone faces, swallowed pilots without retained source faces, exterior detachment/holding, arbitrary tool profiles, oblique surfacing, ramps/helices, multi-axis, probing and other posts remain required unfinished families.
context.inspection: Inspect actual native tool/controller and physical profile, every intended source hole, ordered motion/return planes and continuous removal. Under evolvingStock every expanded motion is checked against its actual prefix stock; rapid motion never removes material. Editable witnesses and scalar mass agreement alone do not establish authority or clearance.
context.recovery: Correct declared dimensions, depth reference, source target, stock or complete tool/holder clearance. TOOL_COLLISION and TOOL_CLEARANCE refuse unsafe admitted geometry; material/authority failures retain evidence. Use the carried isolated profile and reduced-tool launcher where required. No general edited-CAM adoption or machine certification is promised.
